title: Nut-Hatch

inlines.v: NUT'-HATCH, noun The common name of birds of the genus sitta. The common European nut-hatch is called also nut-jobber and nut-pecker. NUT'-HOOK, noun A pole with a hook at the end to pull down boughs for gathering the nuts; also, the name given to a thief that stole goods from a window by means of a hook.
